test_title: PYST 7: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 11 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

q p _ r _ r q _ p _ r p _ q _ p r _ p _ q

options.text: r p q r r p r q
r p q r r q r r
r p q q r q r p
r p q r r q r p

solution:
Given series: q p _ r _ r q _ p _ r p _ q _ p r _ p _ q

Option 1: **r p q r r p r q**

Filling in the blanks:

q p r r p r q r p q r p r q p r r p r q

This does not follow a consistent pattern. ❌

Option 2: **r p q r r q r r**

Filling in the blanks:

**q p r r p r q q p r r p r q q p r r p r q**

This follows a consistent pattern and matches. ✅

Option 3: **r p q q r q r p**

Filling in the blanks:

q p r r p q q r p q r p r q r p r p r q

This does not create a clear pattern. ❌

Option 4: **r p q r r q r p**

Filling in the blanks:

q p r r p q r q r p q r p r q r p r p r q

This does not follow a consistent pattern. ❌

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
